item: permission-denied / ask reason (1.23): can_use_tool's decision_reason shows as a ↳ note under the card header
branch: ClaudeCli.handleControlRequest forwards request.decision_reason → ClaudeSessionService → ChatPanel puts `reason` on the permission_request frame → renderPermission (85-cards.js) inserts noteLine(reason) after .card-h
provenance: The permission_request frame is ChatPanel's own synthetic shape (fixture 11); `reason` is new on it. The FIELD is the CLI's: can_use_tool's request schema (2.1.251 binary, strings) declares decision_reason as 'Human-readable reason the ask escalated, for the consent line of the host's dialog', beside decision_reason_type ('classifier' | 'asyncAgent' | 'mode' | 'rule' | 'subcommandResults'). No local capture carries one — every measured ask is the plain mode-requires-it kind, which the schema says omits it — so the Kotlin forwarding is proven only by compileKotlin and this fixture pins the JS half. NEGATIVE CONTROL RUN 2026-08-29, wrong-value form: a temp copy expecting '↳ nothing' for the note text FAILED that assert and passed the other four; deleted after the run. Pre-fix, `.card-h + .t-note` is null (renderPermission never drew a note under the header), so the same assert throws there. GEOMETRY ASSERT ADDED 2026-08-29 after the user compared the note's spacing in DevTools: `.card .t-note` (margin attach-gap 0 0 2px, written for the note UNDER the diff) left 0px between the note and the command box. Fix: `.card .card-h + .t-note { margin: 0 0 var(--attach-gap) 2px }`. NEGATIVE CONTROL: the sandbox still serving the pre-fix chat.css read '8/0' against the expected '8/8' (the free pre-fix build); green after restart.

expect.why: the reason sits directly under the header, in the caveat idiom
DISCRIMINATING: --attach-gap above AND below the note (user screenshot 2026-08-29 showed 8/0 — the bottom-of-card note rule has no bottom margin). Pre-fix reads '8/0'.
